title: Changing location resets the Work Orders page as it does today
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · a second location · about 20 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • [Tech-A]: one eligible technician at this location, and an eligible technician at the second location too. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Location Reset" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] led by [Tech-A].
  • [Loc-2]: a second location your user is enrolled at, with at least one work order (customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Location Reset 2", work order [WO-2]).
  • Your note of what List does today when you change location (which page and tab you land on, and whether Assigned to me stays on) - the expected results compare against it as "your note from the preconditions".
  • Names are examples; what must hold: two locations you can switch between, each with a work order.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Create everything below in this location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard).
  4. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Location Reset" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Location Reset": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Lead Technician = [Tech-A].
  6. Make sure your user is enrolled at a second location (Settings > Staff > open your staff record > add the location, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Location 2"; if no second location exists, create one first: Settings > Locations > New Location > fill in and save). Record it as [Loc-2].
  7. Click your initials at the top right > Change Location > [Loc-2]. There, make sure an eligible technician exists (same staff steps as above, with Location = [Loc-2]), create customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Location Reset 2" the same way, and create one work order for it ([WO-2]) with that technician as lead. Change back to the first location.
  8. Before testing, note what List does today when you change location: in List, turn on Assigned to me, change location in the top bar, and write down which page and tab you land on and whether Assigned to me is still on. Change back.
  9. Check the setup worked: at the first location Work Orders shows [WO-1]; at [Loc-2] it shows [WO-2]; you have your written note from the step above; you are back at the first location with Assigned to me off. If not, redo the missing step before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (tooltip "Board View").
  3. Turn on Assigned to me.
  4. Click your initials at the top right > Change Location and pick [Loc-2].
  5. Note which page and tab open, the display, and whether Assigned to me is on.
  6. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (tooltip "Tech View").
  7. Turn on Assigned to me.
  8. Change back to the first location (your initials > Change Location) and note the same three things.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Changing location opens the same page and tab that List opens today when you change location (your note from the preconditions).
  • Assigned to me is turned off after each location change, as it is in List today.
  • The display you chose is kept: Board View after the first change, Tech View after the second.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-E2, S1-E3, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions 853901313 FF-3 / DR-6.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-E2: “Changing location opens that location’s existing default page.”
  • S1-E3: “Assigned to me resets on location change, as it does today.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
